ConfigurableProduct:14934.meta_description: Buy a pink or blue personalised swimming bag to separate your wet & dry items. This kids swimming bag is the best wet bag & kids beach bag.
ConfigurableProduct:14934.faq:
How do I wash my Swim Bag?

To keep your swim bag looking great we recommend that you wash them using a cold gentle wash cycle to remove any dirt or stains.

Can I get it printed without my child's name?

Yes we can print it without a name and just the design. Simply enter some spaces in the name section and our production team will print your order without personalisation.

description.html:
Let your kids dive into the swim season with our Personalised Swim Bags. These vibrant wet bags come in popular pink, dark blue, teal, purple & black colours & they conveniently fold flat when not in use.

Aussie kids & parents love that these handy bags have a lined inside & features a front zipped section for small valuables. Not only are these bags super cute, they're also durable, easy to order & shipped fast in Australia.

Personalised Swim Bag Size: 
36.5cm wide x 41cm high (14.3" x 16.1")

To keep your swim bag looking great we recommend that you wash them using a cold gentle wash cycle to remove any dirt or stains.

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields of this bag for wet swim gear will be what is printed. Please make sure to double check your spelling.

  • High quality water-resistant fabric

short_description.html:
Keep your kids' swim gear organised on pool or beach days with these personalised Swim Bags. Made from top-quality water-resistant fabric, these game-changers are great at keeping their wet items away from the things they want to keep dry.

Each swimming bag is large enough to hold all of your kids' swim essentials & is still light enough for them to carry. Plus, the adjustable straps make it easy for kids of all ages to hold.

Let your little ones customise their Swim Bag in the colours & designs they love or surprise them with this clever personalised gift on their birthday, Christmas or other special occasions.
